newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General plans Miss. distribution site.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General plans Miss. distribution site.

text.p: Dollar General Corp said Wednesday it plans to build a 775,000 square foot distribution center in Indianola, Miss., pending various approvals.
Cost for the facility will be $38 million. It will employ 350 people when it reaches full capacity, Dollar General said.
Also, Dollar General's on-site trucking provider will employ an additional 125 people, the company said.
Construction is scheduled to start in the third quarter, and the facility will be fully operational in late summer 1998, the retailer said in a statement.
The facility could be expanded to 1.5 million square feet based on distribution needs of the company, Dollar General said.
